name: Artistic Partition
title: D. Artistic Partition
legend:
For two positive integers l and r (l≤r) let c(l,r) denote the number of integer pairs (i,j) such that l≤i≤j≤r and gcd(i,j)≥l. Here, gcd(i,j) is the greatest common divisor (GCD) of integers i and j.

YouKn0wWho has two integers n and k where 1≤k≤n. Let f(n,k) denote the minimum of 
k
∑

i=1c(xi+1,xi+1) over all integer sequences 0=x1<x2<…<xk<xk+1=n.

Help YouKn0wWho find f(n,k).
input_spec:
The first line contains a single integer t (1≤t≤3⋅105) — the number of test cases.

The first and only line of each test case contains two integers n and k (1≤k≤n≤105).
output_spec: For each test case, print a single integer — f(n,k).
note: In the first test case, YouKn0wWho can select the sequence [0,2,6]. So f(6,2)=c(1,2)+c(3,6)=3+5=8 which is the minimum possible.
